scientific_integrity: Underlying rooted-forest count and determinantal root-set law credited to classical sources. New contribution assessed only for the sharp complete Fourier cancellation and recovery classification; exact finite checks support but do not replace algebraic proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete graphs with unit edge weights, positive common root activity, integer n at least two. No independent audit. Earlier unindexed signed-root specializations may cover the result.
title: Rooted-forest root profiles on complete graphs: exact Fourier resonances and sharp gaps
